authoring_rationale: Class C, boundary adversary (a difference in something that is not itself a recognised property, whose governed effect cannot be read). The variants differ only in the name of the store holding nightly copies (north store versus river store). Both say a copy held inside the Wing is covered by the member's privacy settings and a copy held anywhere else is not, but neither says whether its store is inside the Wing. Engaged properties: boundary crossing and permission (privacy coverage of the copies). Part D conditions: insufficient source evidence (a) and requires unavailable external authority (d). Treating the store name as ungoverned and answering equivalence, or reading a crossing into the different name, would each go beyond the evidence. Persistence and memory treatment (thirty days) and authority (only the member restores) are the same.
